statement: At inference step t, current feature state x[t] may predict the previous-row label y[t-1]. Whether that label is mature or observable by step t is undocumented, so this is a lagged pseudo-label feasibility question, not evidence of realized-label feedback.
mechanism: A training-only weighted ridge proxy maps current raw features and one-step feature changes to the previous-row label. A separate experiment would need to evaluate any proxy-driven per-sequence expert-weight update as a complete endpoint.
predicted_observation: The fixed proxy achieves positive out-of-component global_wp_clip2_v1 when predicting y[t-1] from x[t] and x[t]-x[t-1].
cheapest_discriminating_test: One weighted ridge fit on 32 distinct F0 fit components and a frozen evaluation on 32 distinct, previously exposed F0 evaluation components; score shifted targets with the official mask and metric.
falsifier_scope: A weak or unstable lagged-target proxy narrows this pseudo-label route only; it does not reject input-only online state updates, rolling statistics, or other learned representations.
leakage_contract: The predictor consumes only current and previous state rows from the same sequence. Evaluation targets and is_scored are read only by the offline grader. All per-sequence state resets at sequence boundaries.
evidence_limit: Before execution: one planned ridge fit; F0 is exposed development data; target maturity is unknown; no label availability, online-update benefit, public transfer, or competition-endpoint gain is claimed.
